description: Create an activity (task, call, meeting, email, or note). Must link to at least one lead, contact, company, or deal — use search_leads/search_contacts/search_companies/search_deals to get the entity id. The result echoes the operating workspace.

assignedTo.description: User id of the workspace member to assign the activity to; null/omit for unassigned.

companyId.description: Company id to link the activity to (from search_companies). Link at least one entity.

contactId.description: Contact id to link the activity to (from search_contacts). Link at least one entity.

dealId.description: Deal id to link the activity to (from search_deals). Link at least one entity.

leadId.description: Lead id to link the activity to (from search_leads). Link at least one entity.

priority.description: Priority. Optional. One of: low, medium, high.

recurrenceEndsAt.description: When recurrence stops, ISO 8601. Optional; only meaningful with recurrenceRule.

anyOf.description: Recurrence rule: daily, weekly, or monthly. Optional (one-off if omitted).

recurrenceRule.description: Recurrence rule: daily, weekly, or monthly. Optional (one-off if omitted).

title.description: Short title of the activity. Required.

type.description: Activity type. One of: task, call, meeting, email, note.

name: create_activity
title: Create activity
